parties: Pravin Varshibhai Haria (acquirer); Aakash Exploration Services Limited (target)
headline: Aakash Exploration Services: Pravin Varshibhai Haria files SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(6) exemption disclosure
sum: Pravin Varshibhai Haria has filed a SEBI takeover regulation disclosure with NSE under Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, reporting an acquisition made in reliance upon an exemption from open-offer requirements.
implication: Regulation 10(6) exemptions (typically for acquisitions from promoters, allotments under employee schemes, or other carved-out situations) avoid mandatory open-offer obligations; filing signals completed transaction under exempted category.
detail: The disclosure was filed on 14 August 2026 by Pravin Varshibhai Haria to NSE as required under Regulation 10(6) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing documents an acquisition of shares in Aakash Exploration Services Limited made in reliance upon an exemption from the standard takeover notice and open-offer provisions. The precise acquisition quantum, valuation, and exemption basis are not disclosed in the headline filing itself and would be detailed in the full Form 10(6) disclosure document.
